# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

But… actually, if you’re asking me to confirm the cancellation, I think I’m changing my mind. Sorry, I know that’s annoying — my brother just told me he’d help me set it up this weekend, so I’d rather keep the grill after all.

Also, while I have you, I have another order with two t-shirts on it, and I can’t remember exactly which ones I bought. Could you tell me which two t-shirts they are, and what materials they’re made of?

For verification, my name is Sofia Hernandez, and I’m in Seattle, Washington, 98193. I don’t remember which email I used, unfortunately.
